## This project does not accept code contributions

Thank you for the work you were about to do. I would rather you knew now than after writing it.

Every line in this repository was written by Claude, under my direction and review, against decisions recorded in the comments. A change made outside that process is one I cannot review to the same standard, so merging it would mean either accepting code I do not fully understand, or spending longer reconstructing the reasoning than the change saved. Neither is fair to the codebase or to you.

The full explanation is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Undisclosed0369/SwiftMediaInfo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

**What to do instead:** [open an issue](https://github.com/Undisclosed0369/SwiftMediaInfo/issues/new/choose) describing the change in words — what is wrong, and how it should work instead. I will implement it, and you will be credited in the release notes. Working out what should change is the part that takes judgement; the typing is not.

**If you would rather not wait:** fork it. The MIT licence exists so you can take this and go your own way, and that is a completely legitimate thing to do.

---

### Documentation, typos and the website

These are the exception. A pull request fixing a typo, a broken link, or a wrong explanation in the README or on the site is welcome — describe what you changed below and delete the rest of this template.
